title: Chapter 1208
text:
The Void Race talent was an important part of Kasuyi's combat strength. Now that most of these talents were frozen, his combat strength was far from its peak, and all his attributes had decreased. Thus, he did not hold back at all in this attack.

This trump card that had been brewing for several days was an explosive skill of Kasuyi's. Its mechanism was similar to his own (Charge — Endless Potential). During the accumulation period, Kasuyi could not use his psychic energy. He needed to compress it in his brain and continuously replenish it with the energy generated by his cells, just like a reservoir. Then, he used his mental power to seal the floodgates. It was like a dam that would only be opened when facing an enemy. The flood would shoot out in one go, and it would flow out for thousands of miles. It was like curing constipation for many days, and it had an extremely high attack coefficient.

Not only did this attack deal high damage, but it also had various negative mental attributes. It could make the opponent enter the (Weakened Soul) state, causing all their attributes to decrease. Depending on the target's strength, this effect would last for hours to years.

Milton was suddenly heavily injured, and his aura instantly weakened. He could only display a portion of his strength. Kasuyi had come prepared, and under his calculations, he had weakened the other party's overall combat strength.

As the irascible Kasuyi sent the other party's leader flying, the other eight people flew into a rage and immediately counterattacked. All kinds of Beyond Grade A attacks smashed toward Kasuyi. Pugilist flames, magic, energy cannons, and Esper Abilities.

Seeing this, Han Xiao sighed. His body flashed, and he stood in front of Kasuyi.

When we first formed the team, we had agreed that he was mainly here to be a meat shield.

How could Kasuyi's delicate body withstand the ravaging of eight strong men? He still had to rely on me, this field that can't be plowed, to be the main tank.

All kinds of thoughts flashed through his mind, and the next moment, the tyrannical attacks of the eight people all landed on him.

Rumble!

All kinds of energy erupted, instantly expanding into a huge ball of light. The ground collapsed, and matter was annihilated and evaporated. The entire planet was like a fruit that had a piece of it bitten off.

A huge ring-shaped pit appeared in the field. It was extremely deep and wide, and the temporary underground base naturally collapsed.

However, when they were talking earlier, Han Xiao had already quietly ordered the troops to move, so what was destroyed was only an empty shell.

As the dust settled, Han Xiao was still floating in the air. He casually patted the dust off his body and said, "This strength is not enough, you guys need to practice more."

The eight people who were preparing to take advantage of the situation to attack were stunned in place, their faces filled with disbelief.

When they saw that their opponent had been hit by eight people's concentrated fire, they thought that even if he didn't die, he would be seriously injured. At the very least, he would be in a sorry state and show some flaws. But they never expected that this guy named Black Star would take a round of concentrated fire head-on, and in the end, he looked like nothing had happened. He was practically unscathed!

How was that possible? Didn't the information say that this guy was a Mechanic?

They couldn't be blamed for being shocked. They had already explored the universe and understood Han Xiao's abilities, but this was the first time they had seen an "indestructible body". Most of them had the same reaction.

While the eight of them were distracted, Kasuyi's actions did not stop at all. After using Black Star as a shield to block the concentrated fire, his psychic energy poured out like a torrential flood, unleashing an AOE effect. It instantly slashed into the mental worlds of the eight people, dealing tons of mental damage. Three of the Saint Grade Supers with slightly weaker mental strength were also blown away.

He was already used to Black Star's tankiness and was not surprised at all. Naturally, he would not let go of this fleeting opportunity and immediately launched a fierce attack on the enemy's weakness.

At this time, Han Xiao also released his Mechanical Force to control the mechanical army. The mechanical soldiers swam around like a flock of crows, constantly firing. The huge lethality made the enemies feel helpless and in danger.

Furthermore, there was a milestone that Han Xiao did not expect to come into play at this time …

[Civilization Leader Assassin] that Lothaire had brought!

The defense and various resistances of the enemies were reduced by another three to seven percent, making them even more fragile.

"I didn't expect this ability to come in handy now that I've really become a wanted criminal …"

Han Xiao was helpless.

The process of the two sides fighting seemed quite long, but with the speed of a Beyond Grade A, from the negotiation to the start of the battle, only a few seconds had passed.

A fierce battle broke out instantly. Although Milton's group of nine had the advantage in numbers and overall combat strength, because they lost the initiative at the beginning, they did not gain any advantage in the hands of Han Xiao and Kasuyi. However, they still had a standard Gold Suit, so their disadvantage was not too great. The two sides were evenly matched.

"I feel that the strength of these people seems to be a little weaker …"

Han Xiao multitasked and looked at the combat information on the interface.

These three Supreme Supers were equivalent to peak Beyond Grade As, but it did not mean that all three of them had extremely high levels of God's Trait Transformation. In fact, only Milton had activated the God's Trait Transformation route.

Back then, when he advanced to level 300, his Energy Rank was around 70,000, and he had entered the pinnacle Beyond Grade A realm. It was only when his Energy Rank exceeded 70,000 and his Energy Rank exceeded Lv.21 that the God's Trait Transformation began. There was a threshold, and not all pinnacle Beyond Grade As had the God's Trait Transformation.

Although Han Xiao did not know Kasuyi's Energy Rank, he estimated it to be above 90,000, with at least ten levels of God's Trait Transformation. As for the strongest opponent, Milton, his Energy Rank was only close to 80,000. Although the other side had one more peak Beyond Grade A, their combat strength advantage was actually not as high as imagined.

As for the other six Saint Grade Supers, Han Xiao also took a look. There were only two S + Grade Supers whose Energy Ranks exceeded 52,000, and the other four were stinky little brothers whose Energy Ranks were between 44,000 and 44,000.

"The quantity is quite scary, but the quality …"

Han Xiao shook his head.

Thinking about it, he and Kasuyi were experts who stood at the peak of the explored universe, even among peak Beyond Grade As. There was no need to belittle themselves.

Of course, the Celestial Star Alliance had close to ten thousand Beyond Grade As, so there should be people who could be compared to the two of them. However, not to mention whether people of this level would work for the Superpower Security Department, even if they did have such experts, they would not casually send them out. After all, the two of them had not shown much strength before. Perhaps in the eyes of the Superpower Security Department, sending out nine Beyond Grade As was already overkill.

Hu!

A Saint Grade Pugilist rushed to the front, raised his Gold Grade blood-red saber, and stabbed toward Han Xiao's eyes.

Han Xiao did not panic and easily dodged. The flaming saber light illuminated his eyes, which were filled with nostalgia.

How many years has it been? Finally, someone is going to attack my face again. I've almost forgotten what it feels like …

He even had the leisure to size up the other party. Then, he threw a backhand punch, leaving afterimages behind. His powerful Strength and Dexterity attributes made his attack speed even faster than the other party, a professional Pugilist.

Boom!

The powerful punch landed squarely on the man's face. It was as if a symphony had been played in the man's head. Gongs, drums, and accordions rang out at the same time. Like a baseball that had been hit by a bat, the man flew out of Han Xiao's sight in the blink of an eye.

Seeing this, Han Xiao nodded lightly.

"Hmm, it seems like even here, the life of a Pugilist is still difficult …"

After fighting for a while, Han Xiao could basically conclude that this hunting team could not pose a substantial threat. Thus, he had more leisure to observe his opponents and collect information.

The other party had nine people, two Espers, three Pugilists, two Mages, one Mechanic, and one Psychic. The configuration of the team was relatively complete, having all five systems.

Han Xiao mainly observed the only Mechanic on the other side, who was a Supreme Being.

Because there were no secondary dimensions here, some of the professional abilities of the five systems had undergone corresponding changes. Although there were some alternative abilities, overall, the strength of these abilities was not as strong as the main universe. For example, some special energy that was born in the secondary dimensions could not be controlled by the people here.

Without a secondary dimensional army box, Han Xiao was curious about how the Mechanics here could summon an army on a large scale.

After careful observation, coupled with the information given by the combat information, he quickly understood the other party's methods.

"First, they innovated the compressed orb technology, creating a special Mechanical Force resonance change. Then, they used an ability similar to Apostilization to give the Mechanical Force new characteristics and change a part of the cells, transforming the body into an army box. "The machines in the compressed orb state can be further compressed and absorbed into the body through the support of Mechanical Force, similar to the secondary dimensional army box … However, this ability has a limit, just like Apostilization. The more machines stored in the body, the higher the load, and it will reduce the upper limit of the user's life force and energy …"

Han Xiaoxin's heart skipped a beat.

This was a feasible method, and the idea could not be said to be novel, but it had its merits. The main thing was that the Mechanical Force conversion technique was very complicated, and it should be an ability that was automatically generated during the Promotion or Class Advancement. However, due to the subtle difference between the two systems here and in the explored universe, the abilities generated during the Class Advancement were also not the same. It was similar to the situation of different branches of the same system.

In comparison, the secondary dimensional army box and Dimension Factory were much better. There was no load, and there was no upper limit to the number of troops stored. However, there was also an advantage to storing troops in the body, which was that they would not be affected by the space stabilizer.

However, understanding the other party's method did not mean that he had deciphered the principle. Han Xiao was still unable to learn this technique.

The two sides fought fiercely without any scruples. The planet was quickly crushed into dust in the universe, and the battlefield changed to space.

Han Xiao was busy observing when Kasuyi's voice sounded in his mind.

"Black Star, why aren't you activating your Mechanical Deity? Hurry up and kill one or two of them first! "

"Why are you in such a hurry? Isn't it good to be in a stalemate now? Let me gather more information."

"I'm out of energy," Kasuyi said.

You want to play me?

This thought flashed through Han Xiao's mind subconsciously.

However, he immediately realized … the other party might really be out of mana this time.

Of course, the battle had only started for a short while. Kasuyi saying that he was out of mana was just an exaggeration. He could still last for a long time. However, from a long-term perspective, his mana recovery method was limited, and he could not last as long as nine people. If they fought a war of attrition, he would definitely slowly fall into a disadvantage. Therefore, he did not want Han Xiao to continue slacking. He planned to take advantage of his good state to get some results first and cut off the enemy's wings.

"Okay, since you asked for it …"

Han Xiao did not mind and was about to activate his Mechanical Deity to go all out.

However, at this moment, something happened.

Milton and the others suddenly stopped attacking and quickly retreated. Complicated and exquisite blue magic patterns lit up on their mechanical suits.

Swoosh!

In the next moment, the nine figures flew into the sky and vanished without a trace.

"Hmm?"

Han Xiao paused and immediately scanned the surroundings with his senses, but he did not find any targets.

Kasuyi also stopped and used his psychic power to scan the surroundings, but he found nothing.

The nine experts who came to hunt him seemed to have suddenly used teleportation magic runes to escape.

The two of them looked at each other, confused. There was only one thought in their minds …

That's it?

"They didn't really escape, did they?"

Han Technician was dumbfounded.

No, I didn't use any strength!

There were no casualties on the other side, and they basically had full combat power. They only fell into a slight disadvantage, but they actually ran away decisively. Are they that cowardly?

Could it be that the Beyond Grade As here are the legendary ones who only know how to fight when the wind is blowing and only know how to fight when the wind is blowing?

Kasuyi opened his mouth and was a little speechless.

When this group of pursuers came, they were very aggressive. He thought that they would not give up until they achieved their goal. He did not expect them to be so skilled in escaping. They came and left in a hurry. They did not even say a word of threat. Their efficiency was unmatched.

"Black Star, do we chase after them?"

"… I'm a Mechanic, not a Mage. Locating the location of teleportation spells is not my strength. Besides, they're retreating strategically, and their people are intact. It's a little too arrogant for us to chase after them. "

"What do we do now?"

"Forget it. They've run away anyway. It's a good time to test the effect of this concealment device."

Han Xiao shook his head helplessly. He took out the green-gold metal plate and injected energy to activate it. He carefully sensed it but did not feel any changes. He could only keep it on his body and keep it in the activated state.

He had obtained all the information he needed, and it was confirmed that the cooperation plan with the Superpower Security Department would not work. Now, he could only choose to look for the mysterious man.

The two of them quickly cleaned up the battlefield and did not stay for long. They immediately left the scene and headed to the location agreed upon by the mysterious man.

…

On the other side, in a certain space far away from the battlefield, nine rays of light flashed, and Milton and the others teleported over.

After taking a deep breath, Milton endured the continuous needle-like pain in his brain and spoke in the team communication channel.

"There was an error in the department's judgment. The target this time is shockingly strong. He's one of the best even among the Supreme Grades, especially that one called Black Star. He has an incredible recovery ability, and our attacks barely pose a threat to his life. With just the nine of us, the success rate of capturing him is too low. Ask for help from headquarters."

"Understood."

The others nodded.

Although they could still continue to fight, they felt that there was no need.

After the fight just now, they had already realized that they might not be able to catch the target with just this number of people, so they decisively retreated and prepared to call for backup without any delay.

The departmental culture of the Superpower Security Department did not advocate showing off. Since they were evenly matched, they could just come back and call for help. Using force was simply a waste of time. Not only was the success rate low, but there was also the risk of sacrifice. The loss outweighed the gain.

So what if the enemy is strong? We have more people, so what we're playing is a roll in numbers!

Nine is not enough? Then we'll double the number of pursuers! Double is not enough? Then we'll double it! I don't believe you can hold on forever!

Anyway, we're a law enforcement department. There's no need to talk about morality with wanted criminals. We only care about the success rate!

The members of the Superpower Security Department had always done this, and the basis for this approach was the existence of the positioning star map.

Anyway, no matter where the target was, the positioning star map could lock onto them again at any time, so there was no need to worry about the target running away. There was plenty of time to deploy troops.

However, at this time, before they could contact the headquarters, the headquarters suddenly sent an emergency communication request.

Milton picked up the call and saw the face of the department leader appear on the built-in screen of the mechanical suit. His expression was solemn, with a hint of anger.

"What did you do to those two fugitives?" the department leader asked.

Milton did not know where the leader's anger came from, so he honestly said, "We just fought a little.

The team unanimously agreed that they couldn't catch the target, so they strategically retreated and decided to call for backup … What happened? "

"I want to know what happened!" The department leader's face was ashen, and he shouted, "Just now, the positioning star map suddenly lost the location of those two people. The targets disappeared into thin air, and we can't find them anymore!"

Milton's eyes widened in shock.

We just retreated, and the positioning star map lost its effect?

How is that possible?

What did those two people do?!

His confident attitude was instantly disrupted.

—

From a Big Boss to a Wulin Alliance Leader, by Xiao Lou Ting Feng Yun. If you're interested, please take a look.
